embeds.title: 🗺️  Guild Board 1.5.0 is out
embeds.description:
Big one. **Game Plan** gives you your own checklist with an arrow to the next stop, the **Tracker** shows what your group has in common, and you can **share or ask for quests** with one click. Zone into a dungeon and it tells you who needs to repair before the first pull.

**[⬇️  Download 1.5.0](https://github.com/KrisHendo09/guild-board/releases/latest)**  then fully restart WoW
